name: Full delivery
description: Carry one admitted Work Item through planning, implementation, checks, review, publication, guarded merge, and terminal provider closure in one Run.

steps.name: Classify the request
steps.description: Name the kind of work the Work Item asks for and restate its request once.

steps.name: Require a clear classification
steps.description: Stop the Run when the classifier could not decide from the text, saying so in words a person can act on, so no later Step reads a placeholder kind.

steps.name: Record the intake decision
steps.description: Write what classify retained into the intake record and export it for a parent Workflow. The record path is declared once as the argument the script writes to, and the intake_record output captures that same path.

steps.name: Select the plan depth
steps.description: Publish the declared depth as this Step's own output, which is what the route below selects a preparation Step on.

steps.name: State what the plan needs to learn
steps.description: Read the Work Item and name the open questions a plan would have to answer. The full depth selects this Step and the shallow depth does not.

steps.name: Plan from the Work Item alone
steps.description: Stand in for the research the shallow depth does not do, so one Step is selected either way and the plan that follows runs exactly once.

steps.name: Write the plan
steps.description: Return the plan the Step below retains, as a summary and the ordered steps. It depends ordinarily on both preparation Steps, so it runs once after whichever one the depth selected and is not held back by the one that was skipped.

steps.name: Retain the plan
steps.description: Write what the writer returned into the plan record the reviewer reads and the approver approves. The plan writer declares no Workspace tool, so the Step that declares the file output is the Step that writes it, and a rehearsal and a live Run reach the record by the same road.

steps.name: Review the plan
steps.description: Judge the retained plan against its Work Item one declared dimension at a time and return a finding for each beside one verdict. A second Agent Profile does this, so the plan is not reviewed by whoever wrote it.

json_schema.description: Identify one exact immutable artifact version rather than only its family ID.
json_schema.title: ArtifactReference

steps.name: Require a consistent review
steps.description: Stop the Run when the reviewer approved the plan although one of its own dimensions failed, saying so in words a person can act on, so the person asked to approve never reads a verdict the findings contradict.

steps.name: Approve the plan
steps.description: Ask a person to approve the exact retained plan file rather than a summary of it.

json_schema.description: Identify one exact immutable artifact version rather than only its family ID.
json_schema.title: ArtifactReference

steps.name: Make the change
steps.description: Ask the implementing Agent to change the Workspace and write the note that explains the change.

steps.name: Decide the check scope
steps.description: Judge whether this change needs an end-to-end check and retain that decision.

steps.name: Run the checks
steps.description: Run the checks the retained scope selected and retain what each one found.

steps.name: Report what was checked
steps.description: State in plain English what was checked and what it found, and give one verdict.

steps.name: Review the change
steps.description: Judge the change against its request and either approve it or raise one concern.

steps.name: Answer the concern
steps.description: Make the one change the first pass asked for and report what was done.

steps.name: Record an unchanged review
steps.description: Settle the sibling branch when the first pass asked for no change.

steps.name: Clean retained temporary files
steps.description: Remove only the already captured intake, plan, and implementation-note files before observing the publication change set.

steps.name: Capture the publication Implementation
steps.description: Capture the publication Implementation from retained runtime facts.

steps.name: Read captured publication paths
steps.description: Read the observer-owned changed-path set from the captured Implementation document.

steps.name: Clean the Implementation capture file
steps.description: Remove the known temporary document after its Artifact bytes are retained.

steps.name: Review the change again
steps.description: Read the change a second time and record the concern it raised as settled or not.

json_schema.description: Identify one exact immutable artifact version rather than only its family ID.
json_schema.title: ArtifactReference

steps.name: Capture the publication Review Report
steps.description: Capture the publication Review Report from retained runtime facts.

steps.name: Clean the Review Report capture file
steps.description: Remove the known temporary document after its Artifact bytes are retained.

steps.name: Run the fast delivery check
steps.description: Run the fixture fast check over the changed Workspace and retain its factual result.

steps.name: Name the Run branch
steps.description: Record the branch this Run publishes its change on.

steps.name: Draft the shipping note
steps.description: Write the text of the note that records what is shipping.

steps.name: Write the shipping note file
steps.description: Write the drafted note to the one path this pack declares.

steps.name: Read the reviewed base revision
steps.description: Project the exact branch base revision covered by CHANGE approval before staging.

steps.name: Approve the reviewed change
steps.description: Ask for CHANGE approval over the exact retained review report and pre-publication base revision.

decision.prompt: Approve this reviewed change for publication from the exact base revision?

json_schema.description: Identify one exact immutable artifact version rather than only its family ID.
json_schema.title: ArtifactReference

steps.name: Stage what was written
steps.description: Stage exactly the paths the writing Step reports having written.

steps.name: Commit the staged change
steps.description: Commit what is staged, so the branch carries something to merge.

value.value: Add the shipping note for this change

steps.name: Read the candidate head
steps.description: Project the exact committed candidate revision used by both delivery approvals.

steps.name: Publish the branch
steps.description: Push the branch, which a Change Request cannot be opened without.

steps.name: Write the Change Request text
steps.description: Write the title and body a reviewer reads before approving.

steps.name: Open the Change Request
steps.description: Open one Change Request carrying the text the Agent wrote.

steps.name: Wait for the checks
steps.description: Wait for the Change Request's checks to settle before a person is asked.

BranchReference.description:
Identify one named branch at an exact observed repository revision.

This immutable fact is returned by a future Source Control adapter after it has
observed a configured repository. It does not select a naming convention, create a
worktree, or guarantee that the branch remains unchanged after observation.
BranchReference.title: BranchReference

ChangeRequestCheck.description: Represent one observed provider check without promoting it to assurance evidence.
ChangeRequestCheck.title: ChangeRequestCheck

ChangeRequestCheckState.description: Normalize observable CI/check progress without treating it as verification evidence.
ChangeRequestCheckState.title: ChangeRequestCheckState

ChangeRequestReference.description:
Identify one provider-hosted change request without inferring review or merge state.

This value links a provider request to its exact source branch and intended target.
It does not authenticate the provider, create comments, approve or merge the request,
or turn provider text into authoritative workflow evidence.
ChangeRequestReference.title: ChangeRequestReference

json_schema.description:
Retain the exact provider checks a bounded wait observed before it settled.

The report is the reviewable half of a check wait: it says what was seen, at which
head, and never why the wait ended. Keeping it separate from the settled answer lets
a downstream Step consume the observations without also carrying a routing value.
json_schema.title: ChangeRequestCheckReport

steps.name: Approve delivery
steps.description: Ask for DELIVERY approval over the exact candidate Artifact and head revision.

decision.prompt: Checks have settled. Approve this exact candidate head for merge?

json_schema.description: Identify one exact immutable artifact version rather than only its family ID.
json_schema.title: ArtifactReference

steps.name: Read the Change Request number
steps.description: Project the number and head revision the merge needs out of the reference.

steps.name: Merge the Change Request
steps.description: Merge the approved Change Request at the revision that was checked.

json_schema.description:
Identify one immutable commit without asserting verification or delivery success.

A future adapter returns this only from an observed provider or Git result. The
reference does not contain changed files, checks, approval state, or a claim that a
workflow can transition because that evidence belongs to separate contracts.
json_schema.title: CommitReference

steps.name: Record that the change merged
steps.description: Move the admitted Work Item to the state that says its change is in, so the closing note is written from a ticket that already carries that fact.

value.value: The change for this Work Item merged into the target branch.

WorkItemReference.description:
Identify one provider object without embedding provider SDK data or credentials.

This is a domain value observed by intake and writeback ports. Its provider name and
external key are stable correlation facts; it does not prove that the remote item
currently exists or that the URL was fetched.
WorkItemReference.title: WorkItemReference

json_schema.description:
Capture the latest normalized provider facts relevant to workflow intake.

A source adapter replaces this immutable snapshot after loading it. The model owns
no routing decision, provider status mapping, or claim side effect. Application
services decide whether an item is claimable from the explicit revision, assignment,
planning, and relationship facts below; adapters do not hide that policy in a
provider-specific claim convention.
json_schema.title: WorkItem

steps.name: Write the closing note
steps.description: Read the Work Item as it stands after the merge was recorded, then return the state it closes in and the note a reader gets instead of the run.
